facts.text: Kill the dragon near Brandonsford for Eric the Reeve's 1000 gold bounty.

George says nothing pierces the black dragon's scales. Vivian says enough faun wine would knock it out so Sir Brandon's magic sword (strong against evil, now held by the party) can be dragged through its mouth as Sir Brandon did. The party has enough faun wine, but must reach the mobile dragon's mouth; Sir Phidipaldi proposes leaving wine-dosed game outside its cave.
George says the black dragon will soon fly and doom Brandonsford.
Lady Hilda will join the party against the dragon if they pay her.
facts.ended_how: used up: Lady Hilda joined the party, recruited with Cedric's promissory note

facts.text: Warwick keeps a magical mithril chain shirt; Dunk says it could help against the dragon.
facts.ended_how: used up: Warwick lent the shirt to the party under the Warwick deal

facts.text: Where did the new dragon near Brandonsford come from?
The wizard Malzazarik and Lady Hilda have joined the party for the dragon hunt, recruited with Cedric's promissory note.
Grimny says the dwarves found the Dragon's Lair cave empty when scouting it, and Dunk suspects Bral invented the dragon to keep people away. Is there really a dragon?
